subject_definitions:
<Video 1> contains only the first rendered frame of the paired training target video, presented as video context for scene appearance and style. Motion and timing come from the separate whitebox source input.
<Picture 1> is a paired reference sheet where the upper panel shows the blocky geometric female character proxy in the whitebox source video and the lower panel provides the detailed rendered woman (<Subject 1>) with a bun, tactical vest, and field uniform.
<Picture 2> is a paired reference sheet where the upper panel shows the simplified wheeled vehicle proxy in the whitebox source video and the lower panel provides the textured eight-wheeled ATV (<Subject 2>).
<Picture 3> is a paired reference sheet where the upper panel shows the basic shelter proxy in the whitebox source video and the lower panel supplies the weathered wooden field station shelter (<Subject 3>).
<Picture 4> is a paired reference sheet where the upper panel shows the low-poly beacon tower proxy in the whitebox source video and the lower panel supplies the red-and-white striped lighthouse structure (<Subject 4>).
<Picture 5> is a paired reference sheet where the upper panel shows the basic observation platform proxy in the whitebox source video and the lower panel provides the detailed wooden deck and railing (<Subject 5>).
<Subject 1> is the female ranger clad in a tan field shirt, tactical chest rig, and olive cargo trousers, replacing the geometric female proxy from <Picture 1> and the whitebox source video.
<Subject 2> is the green multi-wheeled field vehicle parked in the distance, replacing the vehicle proxy from <Picture 2> and the whitebox source video.
<Subject 3> is the wooden open-sided coastal station shelter, replacing the shelter proxy from <Picture 3> and the whitebox source video.
<Subject 4> is the concrete-based red-and-white striped lighthouse on the distant horizon, replacing the tower proxy from <Picture 4> and the whitebox source video.
<Subject 5> is the raised wooden observation platform and stepped walkway, replacing the proxy deck structure from <Picture 5> and the whitebox source video.
the whitebox source video is the reference video governing camera tracking, subject locomotion, timing, and structural layout.

summary:
[video editing] The target video is an edited version of the whitebox source video. Rendered in a colored-pencil illustrative aesthetic, the scene replaces the geometric proxies of the whitebox source video with fully textured subjects: <Subject 1> replaces the blocky character, while <Subject 5>, <Subject 4>, <Subject 3>, and <Subject 2> replace the environment and prop proxies, all while preserving the source video's camera path, timing, and locomotion.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1>: partially_preserved - replaces the low-poly character proxy with the detailed rendered woman from the lower panel of <Picture 1> while retaining locomotion and body positioning from the whitebox source video.
<Subject 2>: partially_preserved - transforms the simplified vehicle proxy into the textured eight-wheeled vehicle from the lower panel of <Picture 2> while keeping its background placement from the whitebox source video.
<Subject 3>: partially_preserved - upgrades the basic shelter proxy to the wooden coastal shelter from the lower panel of <Picture 3> while maintaining its position from the whitebox source video.
<Subject 4>: partially_preserved - converts the basic tower proxy into the detailed striped lighthouse from the lower panel of <Picture 4> while following its horizon placement from the whitebox source video.
<Subject 5>: partially_preserved - renders the basic raised deck proxy as the weathered wooden deck and stairs from the lower panel of <Picture 5> while retaining its exact geometry and stairs layout from the whitebox source video.
the whitebox source video (source editing input): partially_preserved - camera path, timing, and subject animation are preserved while all low-poly visual assets are replaced.

detailed_description:
The video features a colored-pencil illustrative art style, set in a vast, arid sandy coastal plain under a bright blue sky with wispy clouds. Centered on <Subject 5>, a raised wooden observation platform replacing the basic deck structure from the whitebox source video, stands <Subject 1>, a woman with dark hair in a bun wearing a tactical vest, tan shirt, and olive cargo pants who replaces the geometric character proxy from the whitebox source video. In the far background, the red-and-white striped lighthouse <Subject 4> sits on the horizon, replacing the tower proxy from the whitebox source video. Mid-ground structures such as the wooden shelter <Subject 3> and the all-terrain vehicle <Subject 2> populate the dunes, replacing their respective coarse proxies from the whitebox source video. The overall layout, camera position, and subject placement adhere strictly to the spatial foundation of the whitebox source video.
